requirements.text: THE ROLE: SENIOR DIRECTOR - CONSUMER INTELLIGENCE AND STRATEGY​
At OLLY and SmartyPants, we believe the best growth strategies start with a deep understanding of people. As Senior Director, Consumer Intelligence & Strategy, you will lead OLL…
More than a traditional insights leader, you are a strategic business partner who translates consumer, shopper, cultural, commercial, and business intelligence into growth strat…
Define and lead OLLY/SPV consumer intelligence strategy and multi-year enterprise intelligence agenda.​
Translate consumer, shopper, cultural, commercial, and business intelligence into actionable recommendations that shape brand strategy, innovation priorities, campaign developme…
Partner closely with the leadership teams to identify strategic opportunities, risks, and future growth platforms, influencing organizational strategies, and long-term growth pr…
Guide the development of brand, innovation, and commercial strategies through deep consumer understanding and foresight.​
Lead strategic synthesis across consumer research, analytics, trend intelligence, and business performance to shape long-term priorities.​
Ensure robust measurement frameworks are in place across marketing, innovation, retail, and commercial initiatives.​
Partner with Sales, Category Management, RGM, eCommerce and Finance to translate consumer behavior, category dynamics, and commercial performance into growth plans that carry th…
Lead the transformation of OLLY/SPV into an AI-first intelligence organization, redefining how consumer, shopper, cultural, and commercial signals are generated, synthesized, sh…
Build and scale AI-enabled capabilities that help the business identify emerging opportunities, anticipate market shifts, and make faster, smarter growth decisions.​
Reimagine traditional insights, analytics, and research approaches through AI-enabled research, predictive intelligence, signal detection, automated synthesis, and scalable know…
Enable smarter decisions​
Scale intelligence through AI and modern capabilities​
Lead and develop a high-performing team across consumer insights, analytics, foresight, and intelligence capabilities.​
Foster a culture of curiosity, strategic thinking, experimentation, and continuous learning.​
Establish clear priorities, coach talent, and build capabilities that elevate the impact of the function.​
Create strong alignment and collaboration across OLLY and SPV insights resources, ensuring the function operates with clear priorities and consistent enterprise impact.​
You are a highly strategic, consumer and growth-obsessed leader who thrives at the intersection of insights, analytics, strategy, and business growth. You possess an unusual abi…
You are equally comfortable discussing consumer motivations, innovation platforms, commercial performance, marketing effectiveness, future trends, and AI-enabled capabilities. Y…
15+ years of progressive experience across consumer insights, strategy, analytics, innovation, consulting, marketing, or related disciplines.​
Strong business acumen, senior stakeholder partnership, and ability to build alignment and drive action.​
Ability to translate consumer understanding into strategic priorities and business outcomes.​
Proven ability to define and lead a consumer intelligence strategy and multi-year enterprise intelligence agenda.​
